eligibilityCriteria.eligibilityDescription_md:
1. The girl student should belong to the tribal class of Rajasthan.
1. The girl student should be regularly studying general education in a private/government college.
1. The parent/guardian/guardian/husband of the student should not be an income taxpayer.
1. After passing the board examination, there should not be any gap in the continuous study of the student applying for the scheme.
1. The student who is studying by living in a hostel run by the government. They will not be entitled to benefit under the said scheme.
1. Must have Vaidya Bhamashah card and Aadhaar card.
1. The girl student should be a native of Rajasthan.

1. Applicant to log in to RajSSO Portal using his/her SSOID.  
2. If SSOID is not available then the applicant to first register on RajSSO Portal to create SSOID and update SSO Profile at first login.  
3. After successful authentication/login and updation of the SSOID Profile and select the scheme name. 
4. Select his/her name, the bank account and fill in personal details.
5. Upload the required document.
6. Click the "SUBMIT" button.

faqs.question: किन दस्तावेजों की आवश्यकता है?

children.text: 1. आधार कार्ड। 2. माता-पिता/अभिभावक की वार्षिक आय-गैर-कर दाता। 3. जनाधार कार्ड परिवार और छात्र का विवरण। 4. बैंक विवरण परिवार के मुखिया या छात्र के जनाधार कार्ड से जुड़ा हुआ है। 5. जाति प्रमाण पत्र. जन्म प्रमाण पत्र।

faqs.answer_md: 1. Aadhaar Card. 2. Annual Income Of The Parent / Guardian - Non-Tax Payee. 3. Janaadhaar Card Details Of Family And Student. 4. Bank Details Linked With the Janaadhaar Card Of Either The Family Head Or Student. 5. Caste Certificate.Birth Certificate.
